scenarios.situation: Exam tomorrow morning. You haven't studied anything.

choices.label: Start a new Netflix series 🎬
choices.immediate: You start 'Dark'. Just one episode, you said.
choices.tomorrow: You've watched 6 episodes. Exam starts in 2 hours. You open your book and cry.
choices.oneMonth: You failed. You're now a Netflix recommendation algorithm expert. Applying for influencer jobs.

narratorLines.savage: Incredible. Absolutely galaxy-brained strategy. You'll study in hell.
narratorLines.motivational: You're investing in cultural knowledge! (You're cooked.)

choices.label: Reorganize your entire room 🧹
choices.immediate: You start 'just moving the desk'. 4 hours later you're buying new shelves on Amazon.
choices.tomorrow: Clean room. Zero knowledge. 100% vibes. You walk into the exam hall with immaculate energy and no answers.
choices.oneMonth: You failed but your room looks stunning. Interior design career incoming.

narratorLines.savage: Priorities: room aesthetic > passing semester. Respect, honestly.
narratorLines.motivational: A clean space = a clear mind! (That won't help with derivatives.)
narratorLines.emotional: You were avoiding it... we all knew it...

choices.label: Take a 5 min nap 😴 (dangerous)
choices.immediate: You set 4 alarms. You sleep through all of them with zero hesitation.
choices.tomorrow: You wake up at 11am. Exam was at 9am. You stare at the ceiling for 40 minutes.
choices.oneMonth: You missed the exam. The professor knows your name now but not in a good way. You explain 'the nap' to your parents.

narratorLines.savage: 5 minutes. Sure. 5 minutes into what dimension exactly?
narratorLines.motivational: Rest is productive! You're just... very productive. Too productive.
narratorLines.emotional: The alarms were right there... they tried to save you...

scenarios.situation: Your crush just texted 'hey' at 11pm. This is your moment.

choices.label: Spend 45 mins drafting the perfect reply ✍️
choices.immediate: You've written and deleted 12 versions. Your friends are reviewing draft #8.
choices.tomorrow: You sent 'hey!' back. They replied 'lol' and went offline. Your soul left your body.
choices.oneMonth: You're still analyzing what 'lol' meant. You made a spreadsheet.

narratorLines.emotional: Every word matters... you just needed the RIGHT words... it's okay...

choices.label: Send a meme instead of replying 🐸
choices.immediate: You sent a frog meme. No context. At 11:43pm.
choices.tomorrow: They screenshot it and sent it to their friends. You're now known as 'frog person'.
choices.oneMonth: They call you frog person affectionately now. This might actually be working.

narratorLines.savage: That's genuinely your best move. Somehow.
narratorLines.emotional: You were scared... so you chose chaos... relatable...

choices.label: Confess your feelings immediately 💀
choices.immediate: You sent a 4-paragraph feelings essay. Unedited. At midnight.
choices.tomorrow: They left you on 'seen' for 14 hours. You check your phone every 30 seconds.
choices.oneMonth: They said 'i think of you as a friend'. You're processing it with a therapist.

narratorLines.savage: You didn't hesitate. You didn't think. You DEPLOYED. Respect and condolences.
narratorLines.motivational: Vulnerability is strength! (please get off your phone.)
narratorLines.emotional: Oh... oh no... oh you brave, foolish soul...

scenarios.situation: Group project due in 3 days. Nobody has started. You're the smart one.

choices.label: Do the entire project yourself 😤
choices.immediate: You work for 9 hours straight. Your groupmates are posting reels.
choices.tomorrow: You submit it. Everyone gets the same grade. One teammate says 'thanks bro, great teamwork'.
choices.oneMonth: You're in therapy unpacking a deep hatred of group work. Self-diagnosis: control issues.

narratorLines.savage: Martyrdom is a choice. You chose it enthusiastically.
narratorLines.motivational: Teamwork means one team, one worker! That worker is you!
narratorLines.emotional: You just... wanted it done right... you deserved better teammates...

choices.label: Ghost the group chat 👻
choices.immediate: You mute the group. 47 unread messages. You watch their panic with detached serenity.
choices.tomorrow: They submitted something. You don't know what. The professor sends you an individual email.
choices.oneMonth: You got a D. Your groupmates got a C. Nobody is speaking to anyone. Beautiful chaos.

narratorLines.savage: The digital disappearing act. Cold-blooded. Legendary. Terrible.
narratorLines.motivational: Boundaries are healthy! (Academic suicide is not.)
narratorLines.emotional: You just... couldn't face it... I understand... I'm worried...

choices.label: Call emergency Zoom at midnight 🕛
choices.immediate: Nobody joins for 25 minutes. Then one person shows up eating a sandwich.
choices.tomorrow: You produce something that technically counts as a project. The formatting is chaotic. The font is Comic Sans.
choices.oneMonth: You passed. Nobody remembers how. The Comic Sans slide is a meme in your class.

narratorLines.savage: Comic Sans. Under pressure. In university. Iconic.
narratorLines.motivational: Late start but you STARTED! Also why is the font Comic Sans.
narratorLines.emotional: The sandwich... the silence... the font... it's a lot...

scenarios.situation: It's 3am. You have class at 9. You're not even slightly sleepy.

choices.label: Scroll TikTok until you pass out 📱
choices.immediate: You go in for '5 minutes'. Your recommended page knows your entire personality.
choices.tomorrow: You wake up with your phone on your face, battery at 3%, and a deep spiritual emptiness.
choices.oneMonth: You've watched 847 videos. You know every sound. You know nothing else. Algorithm complete.

narratorLines.savage: The algorithm won. It always wins. You never had a chance.
narratorLines.motivational: You're learning! About cats! And life hacks! And oh no it's 6am.
narratorLines.emotional: You didn't even enjoy most of them... you just... couldn't stop...

choices.label: Start an existential crisis 🌌
choices.immediate: You begin thinking about whether your choices define you or circumstance does. It's 3am.
choices.tomorrow: You didn't sleep. You have opinions about Nietzsche now. Class was at 9. You were not there.
choices.oneMonth: You're reading philosophy books and alienating your friends. 'Have you considered that time is fake?'

narratorLines.savage: You chose to 3am-philosophy-brain instead of sleep. Peak human behavior.
narratorLines.motivational: Intellectual curiosity is great! Also you have 3 missed calls from your mom.
narratorLines.emotional: The questions haunt you... they always have... since childhood, even...

choices.label: Set 12 alarms and hope for the best ⏰
choices.immediate: You feel strangely at peace. The alarms will handle it. You are at one with chaos.
choices.tomorrow: You slept through alarms 1-11. Alarm 12 jolted you at 8:58am. You ran to class in pajamas.
choices.oneMonth: Your body now pre-panics at 8:45am. It's a trauma response. You call it 'efficiency'.

narratorLines.savage: 12 alarms. You set 12 and still almost missed it. Hall of fame.
narratorLines.motivational: You MADE it! Sort of! In pajamas! Alive!
narratorLines.emotional: The alarm panic... the running... your body remembers...

scenarios.situation: You promised yourself: only 30 minutes of phone time today.

choices.label: One more reel before putting it down 🎞️
choices.immediate: 3 hours later. Your thumb is numb. Your brain is a smoothie.
choices.tomorrow: You have absolutely nothing to show for the last 3 hours of your life. Nothing.
choices.oneMonth: Screen time report: 9 hours/day average. You cry reading it then immediately open Instagram.

narratorLines.savage: 'One more'. THREE HOURS LATER. You're a joke and you know it.
narratorLines.motivational: You're staying entertained! And informed! And empty inside!
narratorLines.emotional: You didn't even want to watch... you just didn't know how to stop...

choices.label: Doom scroll news for 'awareness' 📰
choices.immediate: You're now aware of 14 global crises you can do nothing about. You feel worse.
choices.tomorrow: You bring up 7 different geopolitical issues at lunch. Your friends slowly stop inviting you.
choices.oneMonth: You have anxiety about things happening 9,000 miles away. Your local problems remain unsolved.

narratorLines.savage: Ah yes. The informed citizen who can't sleep and helps no one. Beautiful.
narratorLines.motivational: Knowledge is power! And power gives you anxiety attacks! At 2am!
narratorLines.emotional: The world feels so heavy... too heavy... please put the phone down...

choices.label: Stalk everyone's highlight reels on Instagram 📸
choices.immediate: Everyone is traveling, succeeding, and glowing. You are in bed. In the same position as yesterday.
choices.tomorrow: You feel inadequate about your life, body, and general existence.
choices.oneMonth: You restructure your entire life goals based on someone's curated vacation content. They were miserable on that trip.

narratorLines.savage: Comparing your behind-the-scenes to everyone's highlight reel. Classic self-sabotage.
narratorLines.motivational: Inspiration is healthy! This is not that! This is the opposite!
narratorLines.emotional: You just wanted to feel connected... instead you feel alone... I'm so sorry...

scenarios.situation: You have 65% attendance. Minimum required is 75%. Class is in 30 mins.

choices.label: Skip anyway, it's just one class 🛌
choices.immediate: You're cozy in bed with zero regrets. The regrets come later.
choices.tomorrow: Turns out it was the class where professor announced internals details. You find out from a classmate who is very tired of you.
choices.oneMonth: Detained from exams. You're writing a heartfelt email to the HOD. They've seen this email before.

narratorLines.savage: 65% and still skipping. You're playing Minecraft on nightmare mode.
narratorLines.motivational: Self-care is important! Detention is also happening! At the same time!
narratorLines.emotional: You knew... deep down you knew... and you skipped anyway...

choices.label: Ask a friend to mark proxy for you 🤫
choices.immediate: Your friend hesitantly agrees. They're nervous. You are shameless.
choices.tomorrow: The professor does a spot check. Your friend is caught. They're not speaking to you.
choices.oneMonth: Proxy is officially marked. You and your friend had a two-week falling out. Was it worth it? (No.)

narratorLines.savage: You risked a friendship for attendance. The arc of moral complexity.
narratorLines.motivational: Teamwork makes the dream work! This isn't teamwork! This is a crime!
narratorLines.emotional: They trusted you... and you handed them that risk...

choices.label: Go to class but sleep there 😪
choices.immediate: You attend physically. Mentally, you are in a field somewhere peaceful.
choices.tomorrow: Professor calls on you mid-sleep. You say something that makes the whole class go quiet.
choices.oneMonth: Your answer ('the mitochondria is the powerhouse of feelings') became a class meme. You're famous for the wrong reasons.

narratorLines.motivational: You showed up! Your body did anyway! The rest will figure itself out!
narratorLines.emotional: At least you tried... in your own way... you really did try...

chaosEvents.subtext: Your professor just announced it on the group. 11:47pm.
3 hours ago. No reply. Still watching.
At the most critical moment possible. Naturally.
From the professor directly. With your name spelled correctly.
About the project. That was due yesterday.
No charger in sight. This is the end.

alternateUniverseLines: In another universe, you studied and actually understood the material.
In another universe, you slept at 11pm and woke up refreshed.
In another universe, you replied 'hey' back and it led somewhere beautiful.
In another universe, you opened the textbook before the night before.
In another universe, your group project was collaborative. Willingly.
In another universe, you put the phone down and read a book.
In another universe, you asked for help before it was too late.
In another universe, you're the person your current self checks Instagram to envy.

finalTitles.title: Certified Life Ruiner 💀
finalTitles.subtitle: You've mastered the art of self-destruction.

finalTitles.title: Overthinking Champion 🧠
finalTitles.subtitle: Your brain is a problem, not a solution.

finalTitles.title: Certified Procrastinator 📅
finalTitles.subtitle: Later is now, and now is too late.

finalTitles.title: Professional Avoider 👻
finalTitles.subtitle: You ghost your responsibilities like an ex.

finalTitles.title: Amateur Disaster 🤕
finalTitles.subtitle: You tried to ruin your life. It's a start.

overthinkingThoughts: I had potential. People believed in me.
Everyone else is figuring it out.
What if I just... started fresh? Tomorrow? No wait, Monday.
I should make a plan. I'll make a plan about making a plan.
Maybe I'm not built for this.
No wait, I'm actually fine. Am I fine? I'm not fine.
Is everyone else also this chaotic or is it just me.
It's over. It was over before it began.
I peaked in 8th grade. This is the decline.
I need to hydrate. I haven't hydrated. This is why things are bad.
